competency_comparison.SU-G-31: Exact title match and substantially the same hereditary-colorectal-cancer red-flag recognition, genetics-referral, and surveillance competency; Gastroenterology has independent question allocation.
competency_comparison.SU-MG-10: Broader cross-syndrome gene-cancer pattern recognition and genetic counselling context rather than the same organ-specific learner competency.

groups.original_deferral_reason: The zero-coverage surgical unit overlaps both GI hereditary-cancer recognition and Medical Genetics counselling; the source does not identify one canonical counterpart for a safe direct ownership relationship.
groups.rationale: Targeted canonical search established SU-G-31 as the single natural owner; SU-GS-40 directly cross-links to it.

competency_comparison.SU-E-03/SU-E-05: Endocrinology owns dyslipidemia recognition and cardiovascular-risk assessment prompted by young-patient arcus.
competency_comparison.SU-MG-12: Medical Genetics owns Wilson-disease recognition and action, including Kayser-Fleischer rings.
competency_comparison.SU-OP-28: The established unit combines two separate corneal source nodes and two separable systemic-condition competencies with different natural owners.

groups.original_deferral_reason: MULTI_COMPETENCY_OWNER_CONFLICT: the unit bundles Kayser-Fleischer/Wilson-disease recognition and young-patient arcus/dyslipidemia screening, which have different natural external owners; one PRIMARY_OWNER would distort the established unit.
groups.rationale: No single PRIMARY_OWNER can represent both systemic competencies without distorting the unsplit unit; keep ownership open for later complex-ownership design.
